intro: Visa-free entry, an easy path to a residence permit through a business or property, and the euro as the local currency. An EU candidate since 2010 — the long-term prospect of Schengen citizenship.
climate: Mediterranean on the coast, continental in Podgorica. Hot dry summers of +30–40°C and mild rainy winters of +5–15°C.
mentality: A relaxed Balkan pace: "Polako" is the national motto. Respect for guests, especially Russian speakers.
language_note: Montenegrin is the official language (close to Serbian); in tourism people speak English and often Russian.
visa_note: Visa-free for up to 30 days. A residence permit through a DOO (LLC), a property purchase or employment — issued in 1–2 months.
